sources.entry: borgmatic | Simple, configuration-driven backups with Borg

summary.one_liner: borgmatic is a configuration-driven backup tool for servers and workstations that wraps Borg Backup with client-side encryption and database dumps.
summary.what_it_does: Backs up configured source directories to one or more local or remote Borg repositories, using a YAML configuration file. Retention is set with keep_daily, keep_weekly and keep_monthly options. Checks can be scheduled to validate repositories and archives. Custom before/after command hooks can run around backups. PostgreSQL databases can be dumped and included in backups. Healthchecks ping URLs can notify you if backups stop happening. The README says files are protected with client-side encryption and that it integrates with third-party monitoring services.
use_cases: dumping and backing up PostgreSQL databases
off-site encrypted backups to a Borg hosting service
how_to_run: Install borgmatic and configure it (the README links to install and configuration guides, which are not included here)
Write a YAML config file listing source_directories and repositories
notable: Declarative YAML configuration for backup sources, repositories, retention and checks
Built-in PostgreSQL database dumps before backup
Healthchecks ping integration for failure alerts
Can back up to multiple repositories, including remote SSH targets
caveats: The README is mostly a project homepage; install and detailed usage are behind linked documentation not included here
Off-site storage is referenced as a hosting provider (BorgBase, Hetzner, rsync.net) and the README notes BorgBase referral links fund development
